points: \item Implemented a self-correcting vision-language alignment system for robotic perception tasks, improving semantic understanding accuracy by ~20% and enabling reliable object recognition and scene interpretation in simulation environments.

\item Built a hybrid data processing workflow combining synthetic data generation with real-world sensor fusion (images, text, LiDAR), enhancing model robustness and coverage for multi-modal AI deployment in Isaac Sim and Omniverse.

\item Developed evaluation pipeline using performance metrics and model tuning to assess VLA model outputs across hundreds of robotic scenarios, ensuring production-ready reliability for real-world deployment on robotic platforms.

\item Optimized training pipelines through batched preprocessing and AWS cloud integration, reducing training time by ~80% and enabling faster, scalable model development for vision-language perception systems.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for robotic sensor validation, reducing false detections by 25% while maintaining perception accuracy and improving system reliability in autonomous navigation tasks.

\item Built a National ID authentication system using YOLO object detection, MiDaS depth estimation, and GAN-generated synthetic samples for robust hologram verification, demonstrating expertise in computer vision and deep learning for security applications.
